meta.title: Churn warning signs
meta.subtitle: What comes before client churn
meta.source: SC Engagement List, PB-4108 tickets, attendance and payment logs

indicators.name: Absences at 2x normal
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: Absences per 10 staff in the 3 months before the snapshot are at least twice the average of clients in the same size band that month.

indicators.name: Late arrivals at 2x normal
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: Late arrivals per 10 staff in the 3 months before the snapshot are at least twice the average of clients in the same size band that month.

indicators.name: No call no shows at 2x normal
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: No call no shows per 10 staff in the 3 months before the snapshot are at least twice the average of clients in the same size band that month.

indicators.name: Staff let go by Cloudstaff (AWOL, behaviour, fraud)
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: At least one exit in the last 3 months that Cloudstaff initiated (AWOL, behaviour, fraud, failed review, non-payment suspension, ...).

indicators.name: A staff member resigned
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: At least one staff resignation in the last 3 months.
indicators.feature_label: Staff resignations per 10 staff, last 3 months

indicators.name: Staff exit for service dissatisfaction
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: At least one exit in the last 3 months that the client initiated for service dissatisfaction (performance, attendance, conduct).
indicators.feature_label: Exits for service dissatisfaction per 10 staff

indicators.name: Paid an invoice late
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: At least one month in the last 6 with an invoice paid later than the client's terms.

indicators.name: Unresponsive about a late payment
indicators.kind_name: Early sign we can act on
indicators.test: A late payment in the last 6 months whose Cause of Delay is 'Client unresponsive'.

indicators.name: Headcount down 10%+ in 6 months
indicators.test: Staff at the snapshot are at least 10% below staff 6 months earlier.

indicators.name: Client for less than a year
indicators.test: The client's first engagement started less than a year before the snapshot.

indicators.name: Smallest clients in the band (1–2 or 5–9 staff)
indicators.test: 1–2 staff (in the 1–4 band) or 5–9 staff (in the 5+ band) at the snapshot.

indicators.name: Client gave notice in the last month
indicators.test: At least one disengagement notice with a client reason, dated in the 31 days before the snapshot.
indicators.feature_label: Client-initiated notices per 10 staff, last month

indicators.name: Already lost 20%+ of seats recently
indicators.test: Seats lost (all reasons) in the 3 months before the snapshot are 20%+ of staff.
indicators.feature_label: Seat churn in the previous 3 months

indicators.name: Lost a seat recently
indicators.test: At least one seat lost (all reasons) in the 3 months before the snapshot.
indicators.feature_label: Seat churn in the previous 3 months

indicators.name: Client not replacing staff (pulling out, budget)
indicators.test: At least one exit in the last 3 months not replaced because the client is pulling out, cutting budget, moving onshore or unresponsive.
indicators.feature_label: Not replaced: client pull-out, budget, onshore

indicators.name: Staff exit for business reasons
indicators.test: At least one exit in the last 3 months that the client initiated for business reasons (restructure, slow down, downsizing, budget).
indicators.feature_label: Exits for client business reasons per 10 staff

features.label: No call no shows (vs average)
features.how: NCNS per 10 staff, divided by the average for the same size band that month (1.0 = average).

features.label: Late arrivals (vs average)
features.how: Late arrivals per 10 staff, divided by the same-band average that month.

features.label: Absences (vs average)
features.how: Absences per 10 staff, divided by the same-band average that month. Blank after the absence log ends.

features.label: Any no call no show, last 3 months
features.how: 1 if any no call no show, else 0.

features.label: Any absence, last 3 months
features.how: 1 if any absence, else 0. Blank after the absence log ends.

features.label: Share of invoices paid late, last 6 months
features.how: Months paid late / months in the payment report.

features.label: Late payment, client unresponsive
features.how: 1 if any late month with Cause of Delay 'Client unresponsive'.

features.label: Staff resignations per 10 staff, last 3 months
Headcount change, last 6 months
features.how: Staff at the snapshot / staff 6 months earlier - 1.

features.label: Staff at snapshot
features.how: Active staff at the start of the snapshot day.

features.label: Years since first engagement
built_from: (SC Engagement List: earliest Engagement Date of the client)
features.how: Years since the client's first engagement.

features.label: Exits for service dissatisfaction per 10 staff
Exits for client business reasons per 10 staff
Not replaced: client pull-out, budget, onshore
features.how: 1 if any exit not replaced for a client-risk reason.

features.label: Client-initiated notices per 10 staff, last month
Seat churn in the previous 3 months
features.how: Seats lost (exits not record-only and not replaced, all reasons) / staff.

timeline.source: Derived from SC Engagement List (Engagement Raw A:N)
timeline.definition: Headcount at the client after the day's starts and exits.
timeline.derivation: Running total of seat_added - seat_exit per Shortcode, in date order.

timeline.definition: Staff who left the client that day (any reason).
timeline.derivation: Count of engagements with disengagement_date = date. Still-active engagements (blank, today's or a future end date) are left out. Equals the sum of the exit_ reason columns, and of the three replacement columns.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Exits where the staff member left by choice.
timeline.derivation: Exits only. Reason from the matched UB4108 ticket, first rule that applies: no ticket or cancelled ticket -> unknown; record only; Cloudstaff initiated; client reason (Type of Customer Initiated); Voluntary -> resignation. Here: 'Reason for Disengagement' = Voluntary, with no client reason.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Exits the client initiated because it was unhappy with the staff member's service (performance, attendance, code of conduct).
timeline.derivation: Exits only. Reason from the matched UB4108 ticket, first rule that applies: no ticket or cancelled ticket -> unknown; record only; Cloudstaff initiated; client reason (Type of Customer Initiated); Voluntary -> resignation. Here: 'Type of Customer Initiated' = Service Dissatisfaction.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Exits the client initiated for its own business reasons (restructure, slowdown, role moved).
timeline.derivation: Exits only. Reason from the matched UB4108 ticket, first rule that applies: no ticket or cancelled ticket -> unknown; record only; Cloudstaff initiated; client reason (Type of Customer Initiated); Voluntary -> resignation. Here: 'Type of Customer Initiated' = Business Reasons.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Exits Cloudstaff initiated (AWOL, behaviour, fraud, attendance, medical).
timeline.derivation: Exits only. Reason from the matched UB4108 ticket, first rule that applies: no ticket or cancelled ticket -> unknown; record only; Cloudstaff initiated; client reason (Type of Customer Initiated); Voluntary -> resignation. Here: 'Type of Involuntary' = Cloudstaff Initiated.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Exits recorded for documentation only, e.g. a move to OfficeFLEX; not a real loss of the staff member.
timeline.derivation: Exits only. Reason from the matched UB4108 ticket, first rule that applies: no ticket or cancelled ticket -> unknown; record only; Cloudstaff initiated; client reason (Type of Customer Initiated); Voluntary -> resignation. Here: 'Reason for Disengagement' = For Record Purpose Only, or 'Type of Disengagement' = Disengagement For Documentation.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Exits where the client will fill the seat again.
timeline.derivation: Exits whose ticket 'Type of Disengagement' is Disengagement with Replacement or Resignation with Replacement.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.definition: Not-replaced exits whose reason points to the client shrinking or leaving. A subset of exit_not_replaced.
timeline.derivation: exit_not_replaced exits whose 'Reason for NO Replacement' is client pull out, Subclient pulling out/not replacing, Budget constraints, Moving onshore/other provider, or client has gone unresponsive. Operational reasons (no Backfill classes scheduled, no active projects, changed mind) are not counted.

timeline.source: UB4108 disengagement tickets, PB-4108.xlsx (via the ub4108_ join)
timeline.derivation: exit_notices_received tickets whose exit reason is one of the exit_client_ columns.

timeline.source: NCNS.xlsx, 'NCNS' tab (no call no show log)
timeline.definition: No call no shows that day: staff on the client who neither turned up nor notified, with no logs. Counts from Jan 2026 are about 10x earlier years because recording changed (automatic detection from 2026), so compare clients within the same period, not across years.
timeline.derivation: NCNS 'NCNS' tab rows (Attendance = NCNS, Actual NCNS = No logs), counted only when the staff member was on an engagement with that client on that date: 'Client Shortcode' = engagement Shortcode, 'Employee ID' = engagement CSID, and engagement_date <= Date <= disengagement_date. Other records are in ncns_unmatched. Does not change active_staff.

timeline.definition: Late arrivals that day by staff on the client. Automatic recording started in Q3 2026, so that quarter's counts are about 3x earlier quarters.
timeline.derivation: Tardiness rows (all Attendance = Late), counted only when the staff member was on an engagement with that client on that date: 'Client Shortcode' = engagement Shortcode, 'Employee ID' = engagement CSID, and engagement_date <= Date <= disengagement_date. Records also in NCNS.xlsx (same Log ID) are left out, as they are counted in ncns_incidents. Other records are in tardiness_unmatched. Does not change active_staff.

timeline.definition: Staff on the client who were absent that day with notice (any reason: health, caring, personal, weather…). The absence file ends on 16 Feb 2026: after that date zero means no data, not no absences.
timeline.derivation: Absences rows, counted only when the staff member was on an engagement with that client on that date: 'Shortcode' = engagement Shortcode and 'CSID' = engagement CSID; records that don't match on CSID (it is blank on about 1 in 8 rows) are tried on 'Username' = engagement Username before the @; and engagement_date <= Date <= disengagement_date. At most one per staff member per day (the file repeats some). The same staff-day can also appear in ncns_incidents or tardiness_incidents. Other records are in absences_unmatched. Does not change active_staff.

timeline.source: Late Payments.xlsx, sheets 2023-2026 (monthly days to pay and late flag per client)
timeline.definition: 1 on the 15th of each month the client was in the late-payment report (it had an invoice). Lets late_payment = 0 be read as 'paid on time' rather than 'no data'.
timeline.derivation: One per client per month where the days-to-pay column for that month is above 0, placed on the 15th of the month, only when the client had at least one active engagement that day ('Mystaff Shortcode' = engagement Shortcode). Other client-months are in late_payments_unmatched.

timeline.source: Late Payments.xlsx, sheets 2023-2026 (monthly days to pay and late flag per client)
timeline.definition: 1 on the 15th of a month in which the client paid its invoice late.
timeline.derivation: The sheet's 1/0 flag for that month (the second block of month columns, headers ending '.1'); it equals days to pay > the client's Terms in every row. Same placement as late_payment_reported.

timeline.source: Late Payments.xlsx, sheets 2023-2026 (monthly days to pay and late flag per client)
timeline.definition: 1 on a late month when the client's Cause of Delay that year is 'Client unresponsive'.
timeline.derivation: late_payment = 1 and that sheet's 'Cause of Delay' = Client unresponsive. Cause of Delay is one value per client per year, so it marks every late month that year.
